title: Gallaudet sees the Go Fast video on the Navy Secret Network
place_text: Off the US East Coast (USS Theodore Roosevelt exercise); Navy Secret Network

tellings.quote: I was a onestar admiral and I saw on the Navy Secret Network the Go Fast video.

plain: Tim Gallaudet, who was then a one-star admiral in the US Navy, says that around 2015 he saw the Go Fast video, Navy footage of a small unknown object filmed by fighter jets off the US East Coast, on the Navy Secret Network, the Navy's classified computer system. He tells it because, if true, it means the Navy was passing around evidence of unexplained objects internally well before the public saw it.
